g.text: Quarters since coverage began (0 = first treated quarter)
Callaway-Sant'Anna dynamic ATT, 10 primary states vs never- and not-yet-treated states, 2018 Q1 to 2025 Q3; 20 imputations of
suppressed cells combined with Rubin's rules. Points: 95% CI; shaded: simultaneous band; numbers along the bottom: contributing
Wegovy/Zepbound prescriptions per 1,000 Medicaid enrollees were an estimated 12.2 (95% CI 8.4
to 16.0) higher on average after coverage began (simple ATT, 10 states); 11.7 at +4 quarters,
Leads before 2021 Q2 (before Wegovy existed) are omitted: the outcome is mechanically zero there and they are not evidence of parallel trends.
Simultaneous band = Rubin-combined estimate plus/minus the mean of the per-imputation critical values; the simultaneous critical values are large
(17.9 on average, versus 1.96 pointwise) because several cohorts have a single state, so the shaded band extends beyond the y-axis shown (axis limited
to -25 to 60). Event times with fewer than 3 treated states are grey. Source: CMS State Drug Utilization Data and Medicaid enrollment (warehouse
marts). Gross of rebates; counts under 11 suppressed by CMS.
